audience: affiliate program managers who approve affiliates and track their conversions in Refersion

useCases.title: Review affiliate sign-ups waiting for approval
useCases.text: List affiliates filtered by status, such as pending, and read their profile and offer data. Read the custom fields of one affiliate.

useCases.title: Check one affiliate's activity and tracking link
useCases.text: Read the weekly conversion, payment and click activity of one affiliate, newest first. Generate the affiliate's tracking link.

useCases.title: Trace a conversion
useCases.text: Read one conversion with its affiliate, offer, click, payment method and status.

useCases.title: Find affiliate prospects
useCases.text: List the affiliate prospects that Refersion has already found. The list reads ready results only and starts no new search.

useCases.title: Resend a welcome email to an affiliate
useCases.text: Find the affiliate, then send the welcome email again. The affiliate receives an email, and Refersion allows one resend per 15 minutes.
